test_title: RRB Group D Previous Year Paper (Held on: 18 Sept 2022 Shift 1)
subject: general
question:
Consider the below statements and identify the correct answer.

**Statement - I :** If a substance loses oxygen during a reaction, it is said to be reduced.

**Statement - II :** If a substance gains hydrogen during a reaction, it is said to be reduced.

options.text: Statement - I is false, and Statement - II is true.
Statement - I is true, and Statement - II is false.

solution:
The correct answer is **'__Both the statements are true__'.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• **Reduction Reaction:**

 
 
• Reduction is **a half-reaction in which a chemical species reduces its oxidation number by gaining electron**s.
 
• Reduction is the gain of electrons or a decrease in the oxidation state of a chemical or atoms within it.
 
• Reduction reactions involve:
 
 
• **Addition of hydrogen:**
 
 
• 2N + 3H → 2NH₃ ( reduction of nitrogen)
 
 
 
• **Addition of electropositive element:**
 
 
• SnCl₂ + 2HgCl₂ → SnCl₄ + Hg₂Cl₂ ( reduction of mercuric chloride)
 
 
 
• **Removal of oxygen:**
 
 
• ZnO + C → Zn + CO (reduction of zinc oxide)
 
 
 
• **Removal of electronegative element:**
 
 
• 2FeCl₃ + H₂ → 2FeCl₂ + 2HCl (reduction of ferric chloride)
